skill.name: linear-projects-write
skill.description: Create and update Linear projects through documented Bun CLI commands.
skill.summary: Manage Linear project creation and updates from an AI-assisted CLI workflow.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: The confirmed risks are legitimate but sensitive: this skill requires LINEAR_API_KEY, references a .env credential source, and documents Bun commands that create or update Linear projects. I found no prompt injection text or evidence of credential exfiltration; most Markdown backtick detections are false positives from option formatting.

remediation.suggestion: Document least-privilege token use, avoid committed .env files, and recommend secure environment injection for LINEAR_API_KEY.

remediation.issue: Commands can change Linear project data
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before create or update commands and display the workspace, project, team, lead, dates, status, and priority.

remediation.issue: Partial project name matching can target the wrong project
remediation.suggestion: Prefer project UUIDs for updates or require confirmation when a partial name matches more than one project.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples triggered external-command detections
remediation.suggestion: Separate executable examples from option reference text and label command examples clearly for scanner and user review.

content.user_title: Manage Linear Projects from the CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need fast, consistent Linear project setup without switching tools. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through creating and updating Linear projects with a Bun CLI.
actual_capabilities: Creates Linear projects with a name and one or more teams.
Sets project description, lead, status, dates, and priority during creation.
Updates existing Linear projects by UUID or project name.
Changes project names, descriptions, leads, statuses, dates, and priorities.
Supports machine-readable command output through a JSON option.
Documents Bun runtime and LINEAR_API_KEY setup requirements.
limitations: Requires Bun and a valid LINEAR_API_KEY before commands can run.
Only covers Linear project create and update workflows.
Partial project name matching can select an unintended project.
Commands perform write operations using the token permissions.

use_cases.title: Create Launch Projects
use_cases.description: Create a Linear project with teams, lead, dates, and priority from one request.

use_cases.title: Update Delivery Status
use_cases.description: Change status, target date, or priority for an existing Linear project during planning.

use_cases.title: Automate Project Hygiene
use_cases.description: Standardize project metadata updates as part of recurring operational workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear project named Mobile Refresh for the Engineering team. Use planned status and normal priority.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Planned Initiative
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear project named Q3 Reliability Initiative for Engineering and Platform. Assign Alex Rivera as lead, start on 2026-08-01, target 2026-10-15, and set high priority.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing Project
prompt_templates.scenario: Modify a project after planning changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the Linear project named Mobile Refresh. Change status to started, set the target date to 2026-09-30, and update the lead to Jordan Lee.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Apply Project Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with confirmation before write actions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare updates for the Linear project named Platform Migration. Show the exact project match and planned field changes before running any command.

output_examples.input: Create Mobile Refresh for Engineering with Jordan Lee as lead and a September target date.
output_examples.output: Created the Mobile Refresh project for Engineering, assigned Jordan Lee, and set the requested target date.

output_examples.input: Move Platform Migration to started status and raise priority.
output_examples.output: Updated Platform Migration to started status and changed priority to high after matching the project.

output_examples.input: Remove the lead from Old Project and rename it Archive Cleanup.
output_examples.output: Renamed the project to Archive Cleanup and removed the assigned lead.

best_practices: Use a Linear API key with the smallest permissions needed for project updates.
Confirm the matched project before using partial names for updates.
Review status, dates, lead, and priority before running write commands.
anti_patterns: Do not store LINEAR_API_KEY in committed files or shared chat transcripts.
Do not update projects by vague partial names when several projects may match.
Do not run create or update commands without confirming the intended workspace impact.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Linear project creation and project metadata updates through documented CLI commands.

faq.question: Does it require a Linear API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The commands require LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment or the documented environment file location.

faq.question: Can it create Linear issues?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope is project creation and project updates only.

faq.question: Can it update projects by name?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentation says project names support case-insensitive partial matching.

faq.question: Is JSON output supported?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented commands support a JSON output option for machine-readable results.

faq.question: What should I verify before running it?
faq.answer: Verify the workspace, project match, team names, lead, dates, status, priority, and token permissions.
